result.description: A fictional high-refresh studio display built for color-critical work and competitive play alike. The Nebel Forge pairs a 27-inch OLED panel with 2560x1440 resolution, 240Hz refresh, and adaptive sync support. It includes USB-C video input, a built-in KVM switch, and a fully adjustable stand for flexible desktop setups. Tuned for deep blacks, low motion blur, and accurate calibration out of the box.
